# CrewForeman 3.15 — MiMo Code worker (build brief for MiMo)

You are the lead of a team building CrewForeman (crewforeman-mcp) 3.15 in this repo
(`deepseek_mcp/` package, tests in `tests/`, docs in `docs/`). Start by reading README.md,
CHANGELOG.md, docs/, and the modules most related to workers: `harness.py`, `crosscheck.py`,
`providers.py`, `reviewer_vendor.py`, `reviewer_backup.py`, `builder_backup.py`,
`model_usage.py`, `spend.py`, `budget.py`, `concurrency.py`, `server.py`, `config.py`.

## Team
Use workflows/subagents: up to **16 agents in parallel** (process ceiling is set to 16).
First write `MIMO_PLAN.md` that splits the work into independent parts with **disjoint
file write sets**, then fan out. Each agent owns only its files; the lead integrates,
resolves conflicts and runs the full suite. Prefer new modules + small, well-defined
hooks into existing ones over sprawling edits.

## Goal
CrewForeman can control **MiMo Code** (`mimo`, v0.1.17) as a second-vendor worker, usable as
**builder, independent reviewer, or crosscheck crew** (a crew from a different vendor than
DeepSeek). Google Antigravity is OUT of scope.

===================================================================
--- /srv/DeepSeek-MCP/harness-workspace/mimo-315/repo/MIMO_PLAN.md
+++ /srv/DeepSeek-MCP/harness-workspace/mimo-315/repo/MIMO_PLAN.md
@@ -0,0 +1,340 @@
+# MIMO_PLAN — CrewForeman 3.15.0 work split (team lead: MiMo main agent)
+
+Goal: CrewForeman can control **MiMo Code** (`mimo`, v0.1.17) as a second-vendor
+worker: builder, independent reviewer, or crosscheck crew, plus backup when
+DeepSeek is quarantined/failing. Google Antigravity is out of scope.
+
+Rules of engagement (from MIMO_BRIEF.md, all agents must obey):
+
+- Branch `mimo/3.15-worker` only. Small local commits, message style matches
+  `git log`. Never change git config. Identity is `crewforeman-mcp
+  <noreply@example.com>` — no other identity, no push, no tags, no
+  rebase/amend/force, no gc.
+- Work **only inside** `/srv/DeepSeek-MCP/harness-workspace/mimo-315`.
+  Never touch the live install, `~/DeepSeek-MCP/config.json`, or `~/.config`.
+- Temp files go under `TMPDIR=/srv/DeepSeek-MCP/harness-workspace/mimo-315/tmp`.
+- No secrets, no personal emails anywhere.
+- Tests use **fake `mimo` programs only** — never the real `mimo`, never the
+  network. Must pass on macOS/Ubuntu/Windows and Python 3.9–3.15.
+- Each agent writes **only its own file set** (below). Do not edit files owned
+  by another agent. If you need a change elsewhere, implement against the
+  pinned API in this plan; the lead integrates.
+- Prefer new modules + small hooks over sprawling edits.
+- Do not skip or weaken tests. `TZ=UTC bash scripts/ci.sh` must pass at the end.
+
+---
+
+## Pinned cross-part contracts
+
+These signatures/names are frozen. All parts code against them; the lead
+resolves any drift at integration.
+
+### Models and vendors
+
+- Canonical vendor name for MiMo: **`"Xiaomi (MiMo)"`** (consistent with
+  `"Kimi (Moonshot)"` style). Aliases (case-insensitive substring): `mimo`,
+  `xiaomi`, `mimo-v2`, `mimo-v2.6`. Provider id: `mimo`.
+- Default build/review/crosscheck model: **`xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro`**.
+- Default probe/ping model: **`xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash`**.
+- `is_mimo_target(provider="", model="", vendor="")` → bool — true when any of
+  the three resolves to the MiMo vendor via the alias map. Lives in
+  `deepseek_mcp/mimo_worker.py` (pure helper, no I/O).
+
+### `deepseek_mcp/mimo_worker.py` public API (owned by W1)
+
+```python
+DEFAULT_MIMO_BIN = "mimo"
+DEFAULT_MODEL = "xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro"
+DEFAULT_PROBE_MODEL = "xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash"
+
+def is_mimo_target(provider="", model="", vendor="") -> bool
+def build_argv(task, workspace, model, *, variant=None, session_id=None,
+               attach_url=None, mimo_bin=DEFAULT_MIMO_BIN,
+               skip_permissions=False) -> list
+# `mimo run "<task>" --format json --dir <workspace> -m <model>`
+#   [--variant <v>] [-s <session>] [--attach <url>] [--dangerously-skip-permissions]
+
+def parse_event(line) -> dict          # one JSON event line -> normalised event
+def classify_error(message, status_code=None) -> dict
+# {"class": "auth"|"limit"|"network"|"transient"|"permanent"|"unknown",
+#  "remedy": str, "status_code": int|None}
+
+def execute(cfg, workspace, task, *, model=None, variant=None, session_id=None,
+            label="builder", progress_cb=None, sandbox="workspace-write",
+            attach_url=None, cancel_check=None, timeout=None,
+            mimo_bin=None, live_usage_cb=None) -> dict
+# Returns an execution dict compatible with harness._execute_once output:
+#   status ("ok"|"error"|"stopped"), answer, exit_code, error, tools_used,
+#   events, output_files, seconds, stderr_tail, session_logs, tokens_in,
+#   cache_read_tokens, tokens_out, reasoning_tokens, total_tokens,
+#   estimated_cost_usd, cost_source ("mimo_events"), cost_known, models,
+#   usage, stalled, timed_out, stop_reason, transport ("mimo"),
+#   transport_session_id, sandbox, os_sandbox, role (caller adds role).
+# `usage` shape mirrors model_usage: {"input_tokens", "cache_read_tokens",
+#   "output_tokens", "reasoning_tokens", "total_tokens", "models",
+#   "estimated_cost_usd", "cost_known"}.
+
+class MimoServer:
+    """Lifecycle for `mimo serve` + `mimo run --attach <url>`."""
+    def __init__(self, cfg, *, mimo_bin=None, host="127.0.0.1", port=0,
+                 ready_timeout=20.0): ...
+    def start(self) -> str            # returns attach url; raises on failure
+    def ready(self) -> bool           # HTTP GET <url>/healthz (fallback: TCP)
+    def stop(self, timeout=5.0) -> None   # terminate group; kill after timeout
+    def cleanup(self) -> None         # idempotent; used in finally / crash
+
+def ping(cfg, *, model=None, mimo_bin=None, timeout=45.0) -> dict
+# {"ok": bool, "answer": str, "error": str|None} — sends
+# "Reply with exactly READY and nothing else." (same contract as dsh preflight)
+```
+
+Event stream contract (`mimo run --format json`, JSONL on stdout) that the
+fake `mimo` programs emit and `parse_event` accepts:
+
+- `{"type": "text", "data": {"text": "..."}}` — streamed text; the last text is
+  the final answer.
+- `{"type": "step_start", "data": {"name": "..."}}` — step begins.
+- `{"type": "step_finish", "data": {"tokens": {"total": N, "input": N,
+  "output": N, "reasoning": N, "cache": N}}}` — usage per step.
+- `{"type": "tool_use", "data": {"name": "bash", "input": {...}}}` — tool call.
+- `{"type": "error", "error": {"data": {"message": "...", "statusCode": 401}}}`
+  — error; statusCode 401/403 → auth, 429 → limit, network text → network.
+
+Token totals accumulate across `step_finish` events. Files changed: post-run
+workspace scan (mtime >= start), same noise filter approach as harness
+(`output_files`). Session id: `-s <session>` resumes; the session id is
+returned as `transport_session_id` (parse from events if present, else the
+`-s` value passed in).
+
+Error remedies (vendor-correct): auth → "Run `mimo providers login` for the
+`xiaomi` provider (or set `MIMO_API_KEY` / the provider's API key) and retry.";
+limit → "MiMo concurrency/rate limit reached: reduce parallel agents and
+retry; CrewForeman will back off automatically where it can."; network →
+"Network failure talking to MiMo: check connectivity and retry."
+
+### `deepseek_mcp/mimo_permissions.py` public API (owned by W2)
+
+```python
+PRESETS = ("read-only", "workspace-write", "danger-full-access")
+
+def render_mimocode_jsonc(preset, workspace, *, extra_deny=None) -> str
+def write_run_config(preset, workspace, *, path=None) -> Path
+# Writes <workspace>/mimocode.jsonc (per-run, never the user's global config).
+def skip_permissions_args(cfg) -> list
+# Returns ["--dangerously-skip-permissions"] ONLY when cfg.mimo_skip_permissions
+# is truthy; otherwise []. Never returns --yolo.
+def preset_for_role(role, cfg=None) -> str
+# reviewer/audit/probe -> "read-only"; builder/crosscheck/finisher/revision ->
+# "workspace-write"; explicit cfg.mimo_sandbox or tool sandbox wins if valid.
+```
+
+Permission map (mirrors the repo-root `mimocode.jsonc` shape): keys
+`read`, `edit`, `glob`, `grep`, `list`, `bash`, `task`, `actor`, `skill`,
+`webfetch`, `external_directory` (+ `lsp` if trivial).
+
+- read-only: read/glob/grep/list = allow; edit = deny; bash = deny-map that
+  allows only non-mutating commands (`ls*`, `cat*`, `git status*`, `git log*`,
+  `git diff*`, `find*`, `wc*`, `head*`, `tail*`, `grep*`, `pwd`, `which*`);
+  task/actor = allow; external_directory = `{ "*": "deny", "<workspace>/**":
+  "allow" }`. **A read-only reviewer must deny edit and mutating bash.**
+- workspace-write: read/glob/grep/list/edit = allow; bash allow with deny rules
+  (`git push*`, `git * push*`, `gh *`, `git config --global*`, `git config
+  --system*`, `git commit --amend*`, `git rebase*`, `git reset --hard*`, `git
+  filter-branch*`, `git gc*`, `git tag*`, `sudo *`, `rm -rf /*`, `rm -rf ~*`,
+  `*--dangerously-skip-permissions*`, `*--yolo*`); external_directory as above.
+- danger-full-access: all allow (documented as opt-in only).
+- `skip_permissions_args` only behind config `mimo_skip_permissions` (env
+  `DSH_MIMO_SKIP_PERMISSIONS` / `DEEPSEEK_MIMO_SKIP_PERMISSIONS`), documented.
+
+### `deepseek_mcp/mimo_concurrency.py` public API (owned by W3)
+
+```python
+DEFAULT_LIMIT = lambda cpu: min(16, 2 * cpu)   # MiMo documented default
+
+def read_mimo_limit(cfg=None, *, project_dir=None) -> dict
+# {"limit": int|None, "source": "global_config"|"project_config"|"default",
+#  "values_seen": {...}}
+# Reads `workflow.maxConcurrentAgents` from global
+# ~/.config/mimocode/mimocode.jsonc and the project mimocode.jsonc
+# (project_dir or cwd); NEVER writes those files. Effective limit = MAX of
+# the values found (global, project, built-in default min(16, 2*CPU)).
+# An explicit CrewForeman override cfg.mimo_max_concurrent_agents wins.
+
+def get_concurrency(cfg=None, **kwargs) -> int
+def note_limit_error(cfg, source="limit_error") -> dict
+# Back off after limit/429: record the event (state file under cfg.state_dir)
+# and return the reduced suggestion (e.g. max(1, limit // 2)); the caller
+# records it. Cached detection lives in the same state dir, never in ~/.config.
+```
+
+### Crosscheck crew vendor selection (owned by W6 in `deepseek_mcp/crosscheck.py`)
+
+```python
+def select_crew_target(cfg, args, builder_target=None) -> dict
+# {"provider": str, "model": str, "vendor": str,
+#  "builder_vendor": str, "different_vendor": bool, "source": "explicit"|"auto"}
+# Explicit args/config: crosscheck_crew_provider / crosscheck_crew_model
+# (config keys + tool params, same names). Auto: pick a vendor DIFFERENT from
+# builder_target's vendor — Xiaomi (MiMo) with xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro when the
+# builder is DeepSeek (and vice versa: deepseek when builder is MiMo); else
+# the first configured different vendor. An explicit choice whose vendor
+# equals the builder's vendor raises CrosscheckCrewVendorConflict (subclass of
+# ValueError with .reason) — "the checker crew is a different vendor" is
+# enforced, not advisory.
+```
+
+### Config keys (owned by W7 in `deepseek_mcp/config.py`)
+
+Add to `DEFAULTS` + `ENV_MAP` (+ int/bool/str classification lists) exactly:
+
+| key | default | env aliases |
+|---|---|---|
+| `mimo_bin` | `"mimo"` | `MIMO_BIN`, `DSH_MIMO_BIN`, `DEEPSEEK_MIMO_BIN` |
+| `mimo_default_model` | `"xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro"` | `MIMO_MODEL`, `DSH_MIMO_MODEL` |
+| `mimo_probe_model` | `"xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash"` | `MIMO_PROBE_MODEL` |
+| `mimo_variant` | `""` | `MIMO_VARIANT` |
+| `mimo_skip_permissions` | `false` (bool) | `DSH_MIMO_SKIP_PERMISSIONS`, `DEEPSEEK_MIMO_SKIP_PERMISSIONS` |
+| `mimo_sandbox` | `""` (empty = per-role preset) | `DSH_MIMO_SANDBOX` |
+| `mimo_max_concurrent_agents` | `0` (0 = auto-detect) | `DSH_MIMO_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS` |
+| `mimo_use_serve` | `false` (bool) | `DSH_MIMO_USE_SERVE` |
+| `mimo_serve_host` | `"127.0.0.1"` | `DSH_MIMO_SERVE_HOST` |
+| `mimo_serve_port` | `0` (0 = auto) | `DSH_MIMO_SERVE_PORT` |
+| `mimo_prices` | `{}` (map model → prices) | `DSH_MIMO_PRICES` (JSON) |
+| `crosscheck_crew_provider` | `""` | `DSH_CROSSCHECK_CREW_PROVIDER`, `DEEPSEEK_CROSSCHECK_CREW_PROVIDER` |
+| `crosscheck_crew_model` | `""` | `DSH_CROSSCHECK_CREW_MODEL`, `DEEPSEEK_CROSSCHECK_CREW_MODEL` |
+
+`PATH_KEYS` additions: `mimo_bin`. `mimo_prices` is a dict key (no coercion
+change). Bump `SERVER_VERSION` to `"3.15.0"` in this file (W12 bumps the rest).
+
+### Prices (owned by W5)
+
+Builtin (in `deepseek_mcp/api.py`, next to `HARNESS_PRICES`):
+
+```python
+MIMO_PRICES = {
+    "mimo-v2.6-pro":  {"input": 0.435, "cache_hit": 0.0036, "output": 0.87},
+    "mimo-v2.6-flash": {"input": 0.14, "cache_hit": 0.0036, "output": 0.28},
+}
+```
+
+(USD per 1M tokens; `cache_hit` falls back to `input` when only input/output
+are known. Config `mimo_prices` overrides per model: `{"<model>": {"input":
+F, "cache_hit": F, "output": F}}`. Unknown model → **cost unknown, never 0**.)
+Reasoning tokens count as output unless a price says otherwise. Per-vendor
+split: `model_usage` rows already carry a provider label; add a
+`by_vendor` rollup (vendor → tokens/cost/cost_known) to the ledger output,
+and surface it in run records (`model_usage.by_vendor`), job status and the
+spend/waste reports.
+
+### Role routing (owned by W6)
+
+- `reviewer_vendor.py`: add `"Xiaomi (MiMo)"` to `VENDORS`, aliases
+  `mimo`/`xiaomi`, `_PROVIDERS` entry `mimo`; `_VENDOR_MARKERS` in
+  `model_policy.py` gains `("Xiaomi (MiMo)", ("mimo", "xiaomi"))`.
+- `builder_backup.py` / `reviewer_backup.py`: MiMo targets acceptable as
+  backup (they resolve via `model_policy.resolve_target` — ensure provider
+  `mimo` resolves and vendor labels to `Xiaomi (MiMo)`); backup preflight
+  ping uses `mimo_probe_model` when the backup target is MiMo.
+- Review preflight ping for MiMo candidates routes through
+  `mimo_worker.ping` (W9 wires the dispatch; W6 makes `reviewer_vendor`
+  treat a MiMo candidate as cross-vendor vs DeepSeek builders).
+
+### Fake `mimo` test tooling (owned by W11 in `tests/mimo_fakes.py`, `tests/build_fake_mimo.py`)
+
+```python
+def write_fake_mimo(path, mode="ok") -> Path
+# Returns the executable to set as MIMO_BIN (uses tests/fakes.write_fake_script
+# on Windows). Modes: ok, text_only, error_auth, error_limit, error_network,
+# slow, silent, flaky, serve, attach, verbose.
+def base_env(root, fake_mimo=None, **kw) -> dict
+# Mirrors tests/fakes.base_env: MIMO_BIN, FAKE_MIMO_ARGV, FAKE_MIMO_MODE,
+# FAKE_MIMO_SLEEP, FAKE_MIMO_SESSIONS, FAKE_MIMO_SERVE_URL, TMPDIR-safe.
+```
+
+`build_fake_mimo.py` mirrors `tests/build_fake_dsh.py` (compiled launcher
+wrapper for Windows). The `serve` mode starts a stdlib `http.server` on
+`127.0.0.1:<port from --port or env>` with `GET /healthz` → 200 "ok", runs
+until SIGTERM/SIGINT. `attach` mode accepts `--attach <url>` and otherwise
+behaves like `ok`. All fake event streams are the JSONL contract above.
+
+### Test isolation guard (owned by W10)
+
+- Fix the root cause of the suite writing fake run records (prompts like
+  "Write one note.") into the real `~/DeepSeek-MCP/runs`.
+- `tests/isolation.py` gains a write guard: while a case is active, any
+  `deepseek_mcp.store` write whose resolved target is outside the case dir
+  (or inside the real home state root `~/DeepSeek-MCP`, or `<repo>/runs`)
+  raises immediately with a clear message.
+- New `tests/test_v3150_isolation_guard.py`: (a) the guard fires on a
+  deliberate real-home write; (b) a scan/assert that no run record with the
+  fake prompts exists under the real home state dir after the suite (or that
+  the default `log_dir` can never be selected while the hook is active).
+- Other agents' tests must be isolated by construction (use
+  `tests.isolation` / temp roots / `tests.mimo_fakes.base_env`).
+
+---
+
+## Work parts and disjoint file write sets
+
+12 parallel agents (≤16 ceiling). Each agent: implement, write its own tests,
+run them, commit its files in small commits with clear messages. Do **not**
+run the full suite (the lead integrates and runs `scripts/ci.sh`).
+
+| ID | Part | Owned files (writes) | Notes |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| W1 | MiMo worker adapter (run/parse/errors/session/serve-attach/ping) | `deepseek_mcp/mimo_worker.py` (new), `tests/test_mimo_worker.py` (new) | Code against W2/W11 contracts; stub-safe imports. |
+| W2 | Per-run `mimocode.jsonc` permissions | `deepseek_mcp/mimo_permissions.py` (new), `tests/test_mimo_permissions.py` (new) | Pure stdlib. |
+| W3 | MiMo concurrency detection + backoff record | `deepseek_mcp/mimo_concurrency.py` (new), `tests/test_mimo_concurrency.py` (new) | Reads mimocode.jsonc (global+project) read-only. |
+| W4 | DSH concurrency probe fix (root cause) | `deepseek_mcp/concurrency.py` (edit), `tests/test_concurrency.py` (edit) | Fix "probe produced no readable result" being cached as `source: fallback`; find root cause; regression test. Do not touch mimo_concurrency. |
+| W5 | Prices, usage & per-vendor cost split | `deepseek_mcp/api.py`, `deepseek_mcp/model_usage.py`, `deepseek_mcp/spend.py`, `deepseek_mcp/waste_report.py`, `deepseek_mcp/status.py` (edits), `tests/test_v3150_cost.py` (new) | Unknown model = cost unknown, never 0. |
+| W6 | Roles & vendor routing (reviewer/backup/crosscheck crew selection) | `deepseek_mcp/reviewer_vendor.py`, `deepseek_mcp/model_policy.py`, `deepseek_mcp/builder_backup.py`, `deepseek_mcp/reviewer_backup.py`, `deepseek_mcp/crosscheck.py` (edits), `tests/test_v3150_routing.py` (new) | Implements `crosscheck.select_crew_target`. |
+| W7 | Config keys + version constant | `deepseek_mcp/config.py` (edit), `tests/test_v3150_config.py` (new) | Key table above; `SERVER_VERSION = "3.15.0"`. |
+| W8 | Server tool params | `deepseek_mcp/server.py` (edit), `tests/test_v3150_server_params.py` (new) | `crosscheck_crew_provider`/`crosscheck_crew_model` params; accept `mimo` provider values. |
+| W9 | Harness integration (dispatch to mimo_worker) | `deepseek_mcp/harness.py` (edit), `tests/test_v3150_integration.py` (new) | Small hook in `_execute_once`; crosscheck wiring per W6 API; usage passthrough. Runs after W1–W3, W5–W7 APIs are pinned (parallel OK — code against this plan). |

 ### Test isolation guard (owned by W10)
 
+Root cause (verified by forensics on `~/DeepSeek-MCP/runs`): fixtures call
+`load_config(config_path=..., env={hand-built dict})` with **no state/log
+keys**; `load_config(env=explicit)` ignores `os.environ`, so the isolation
+overlay is invisible and `cfg.log_dir` falls back to the real
+`~/DeepSeek-MCP/runs` (`config.py:87`); `store.save_run` then writes run
+records home (401 "Write one note." records, all from
+`tests/test_v3140_resume_attention.py` before its partial fix in `fe51999`).
+Same hole at HEAD in `test_v3120_integration.py`, `test_v3100_job_seconds.py`,
+`test_concurrency.py`, `test_v320_stall.py`, `test_v3143_fix2.py`,
+`test_v395_practices_core.py` and release tests with `env={}`. Secondary hole:
+`jobs._worker_env`/`safety.scrubbed_env` drops `DEEPSEEK_MCP_CONFIG`, so job
+children can reload config with home defaults.
+
